title: Kevin Warren: No deadline on Bears stadium solution, but we should know by early summer

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin Warren: No deadline on Bears stadium solution, but we should know by early summer
sources.description: Bears president and CEO Kevin Warren is expecting to have a stadium solution in place for the club by late spring or early summer of this year, Warren said in an interview with PFT from the annual league meeting on Monday.
